description: Japan corporate deadlines from the business-year end: 法人税 確定申告・納付 within 2 months, 中間申告 (12-month year: 6 months + 2 months; not needed if 予定申告額 10万円以下), 消費税 2 months (+1 month with 延長特例 and 消費税申告期限延長届出書). The 延長特例 length for 法人税 is not computed. Japan (国税庁), as of 2026-11-22. General information only: not tax or company-law advice, no filing. Weekends move to Monday; public holidays are not applied.
